exec: // Nextcloud's OCS/CSRF middleware rejects every state-changing request
// that does not carry `OCS-APIRequest: true` with HTTP 412, BEFORE the
// request ever reaches a DocuDesk controller. Not one of this
// collection's requests declared the header, so all 39 of its writes
// (34 POST + 5 DELETE) were answered 412 and no write path had ever
// been exercised. Upserting it here covers every request in the
// collection at once, and `upsert` leaves an explicit per-request
// header untouched.
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'OCS-APIRequest', value: 'true' });

item.name: Policy — Detection-time outcomes
item.description: Coverage for the canonical PolicyMatchService::match decision table (entity-publication-policies §3). Exercises the four outcomes — no-match (WOO default), prohibition-only, standing-consent-only, and both-match (prohibition wins). Each item that seeds a policy record cleans it up afterwards so the suite is idempotent across re-runs. Group-permission failures (403/500) are accepted by the seed POSTs because the test environment may not configure the docudesk-policy-admins / docudesk-standing-consent-admins groups; subsequent assertions are skipped when seeding fails.

exec: // The 403/500 guard that stood here called pm.test.skip() and
